verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only goal-level agent runs (e.g. `client.runs.create("Find the top Hacker News story")`) and raw CDP access for your own Playwright or Puppeteer code. Neither is a documented set of DOM-understanding act/click/type primitives on described elements, and nothing shows resilience to selector or layout changes. Whole-task agents and raw CDP are adjacent features, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can drive the page through DOM-understanding action primitives (act/click/type on described elements) that survive selector and layout changes
